subject: ONE hyena in an open shirt, spotted coat, long grin, wiry legs, covering ground in EVERY beat
second_characters: A SWARM of crows on the fence, flapping and spraying white down the posters in EVERY beat; ONE vulture broker in a tie flinging packets past the lens, from 6.20 swallowed whole

props.big: ONE seed pouch hauled the full frame width, never set down; from 3.00 ONE maw on a thick stalk, as broad as the frame
props.small: A SWARM of golden fruit, leaves, clods and torn poster scraps tearing past the lens

environment: a backyard money-garden of round plots behind a long plank fence plastered with bright tattered posters in fat capitals, РОСТ АКЦИЙ 200%, ММВБ, ВКЛАД 25% ГОДОВЫХ, packed top and bottom with diggers and crates
lighting: bright daylight, clear blue sky, cyan edge left, amber fill right
motion_rule: the frame is TALL and the hyena fills at least half its height in EVERY beat, his grin never under a quarter of it. The camera orbits him on a hard arc, the postered fence swinging behind. The world flies at him: soil, fruit and feathers tear past the lens the full frame width in EVERY beat, a new shot size each beat, medium to very close. He covers ground in EVERY beat, leaping plot to plot. ONE hero action per beat.

audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, every line said once, nothing else said aloud, last word done by 5.40, then soil and stalks carry it
audio.lip_sync: mouth to the lens, opening on every syllable
audio.pronunciation: DVAZH-dy, ros-LI, na drozh-ZHAKH, TRET-ye, SYE-lo, vsyo os-tal-NO-ye

timeline.a: already mid-slam, he punches ONE seed in and a sprout rockets up past his grin with ONE golden fruit, soil blasting past the lens
two paces on he punches the next seed in and an identical sprout rockets up with the same fruit, the vulture flinging packets past the lens
he rips the third seed out, it blazes white in his paw as he vaults the fence, crows flapping up and streaking white down the posters
he drives the blazing seed in and a maw as broad as the frame bursts out and bites the first little tree off, leaves tearing past the lens
he hauls the pouch back while the maw swings round and bites the twin tree off, clods blasting past the lens
the maw rips the pouch away and chews it, and he scrambles along the fence after it, crows scattering off
he ducks under the stalk, grin huge, and the maw swallows the vulture whole
he grabs at his shirt as the maw peels it off his back and gulps it down
the stalk hooks his leg and swings him along the fence the full frame width while he rips posters off in strips
it drops him and he lands running, the maw chewing the fence down behind him
the maw drops ONE blazing seed into his paw and his grin cracks wider as he closes it

must_appear: at 0.00 driving a seed into the plot; at 2.10 the posters with crows streaking white down them; at 3.00 a maw as broad as the frame biting a little tree off; at 9.20 it dropping ONE blazing seed into his paw
negative_prompt: subtitles, speech bubble, a voice reading out numbers, a hero stopped to read, a hero running at the camera, a travelling camera, a conveyor belt, a cart, rails, a parked camera, an empty background, push in, wide shot, a small distant hero, letterbox, night, a hero back to the camera, a hero held in one pose, a prop worked in place, a motionless first or last second, a line said twice, speech after 5.40, offscreen narration, English speech, a second hyena in frame
